root_cause.text: In `sound/core/control.c:snd_ctl_elem_init_enum_names()`, the loop failed to stop when the remaining ENUM names buffer length reached zero, so it could call `strnlen(p, 0)` on an exhausted buffer and trigger fortified `strnlen()`/FORTIFY_SOURCE checks before the existing error handling ran.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (buf_len == 0) { kvfree(names); return -EINVAL; }` immediately before `strnlen(p, buf_len)`, and the CVE description states the bug occurs when `buf_len` reaches zero but more items remain, causing `strnlen(p, 0)` and a BRK panic under `CONFIG_FORTIFY_SOURCE`.
